description: Where the workspace's pay as you go stands, in plain words: off, or on with its monthly limit, what has been charged so far this month, what is set aside for work already approved or under way, and what is left for new work. Also how it works, to tell the person before they decide: what work done at a pay-as-you-go price costs, that each job shows an "at most" price it is never charged above, that work that fails is free, and that the monthly limit only stops new pay-as-you-go work and never a live site; with the link to the terms that turning it on agrees to. Only owners and admins see it; anyone else is told so. Turning it on or changing the limit is turn_on_pay_as_you_go; turning it off is turn_off_pay_as_you_go.
